C-rules.note: i think "rules" should become "Advanced Settings". each of the individual cards should become an expandable card of sorts with the menus/options/etc hidden inside. all should start collapsed. each should explain in plain, concise terms what the option does with pros/cons. the titles of each section should be more clear/concise/statement-like

C-perm.note: i still dont think we've sufficiently fleshed out how the list under "add a permission" gets built? some of these are very narrow permissions, and many would probably be fully custom commands or scripts or something, so i doubt we could build a comprehensive list? we need to consider this more thoughtfully. how would a user actually experience the end-to-end flow of adding new automations or managing existing automation permissions for tasks we might not have even considered yet?

Q-unlisted-one.note: fine with two, i think we need to make sure whatever the user selects is accurately conveyed to the model so it doesnt try using unlisted commands in like an always block/skip instead of ask mode.
